DLF01_A.copy: Hook: Walt's overnight tablet cup at 6 a.m.
DLF01_A.prompt: Looking down into a clear drinking glass on a bathroom sink at 6 a.m. after an overnight denture-tablet soak: the water has gone a murky blue-grey with a foamy scum on top, a full upper denture sits on the bottom; the pink acrylic is stained, there is slimy white film and yellow-brown buildup along the gumline and between the teeth, little flecks floating. A tablet wrapper torn open beside it, plain unbranded. Gross-out realism: shot extremely close with the harsh direct phone flash, wet glistening highlights, every disgusting detail sharp. It should make the viewer physically recoil, like an unedited photo someone posted to complain. Realistic, not cartoonish, no blood, no gore, no text.

DLF01_B.copy: The old routine, up close: the soaked denture lifted out of the blue water.
DLF01_B.prompt: A man's wrinkled hand lifting a full upper denture out of a glass of blue tablet water over a bathroom sink at night; strings of slimy film hang from the plate, the fitting side is cloudy with yellowish crust in the ridges, drips falling. Gross-out realism: shot extremely close with the harsh direct phone flash, wet glistening highlights, every disgusting detail sharp. It should make the viewer physically recoil, like an unedited photo someone posted to complain. Realistic, not cartoonish, no blood, no gore, no text.

DLF01_C.copy: The legal pad: her handwritten checklist with highlighter, the cut-out back panel of the box clipped to the top.
DLF01_C.prompt: Phone photo taken from directly above of a yellow legal pad on a kitchen table in daylight. The pad is filled with neat cursive handwriting in blue ballpoint, numbered 1 to 6 down the left margin, some lines underlined twice and two lines streaked with yellow highlighter, plus a small hand-drawn molecule doodle in the margin. Clipped to the top of the pad with a black binder clip is a rectangle of light-blue cardboard cut out with scissors, covered in tiny illegible gray print with one highlighted strip. A pair of reading glasses and a pencil lie across the corner. Flat gray winter daylight from a nearby window, slightly overexposed. IMPORTANT: the handwriting is too small and slanted to read; only the numbers 1 to 6 are clear. No brand names, logos or readable printed text.

DLF01_D.copy: Payoff: Walt, 71, laughing at Sunday dinner at his daughter's table, pot roast, chewing on both sides again.
DLF01_D.prompt: Candid phone photo taken by his daughter from across a crowded dining table on a Sunday afternoon in early spring in a modest Ohio home. A 71-year-old white man with a weathered face, short white hair and reading glasses pushed up on his head, wearing a red and black flannel shirt, laughing hard with his mouth open, a fork in his hand, a full plate of pot roast, carrots and mashed potatoes in front of him. His wife, 68, short silver hair and a cardigan, is beside him, looking at him and smiling. Mismatched serving dishes, a basket of rolls, a pie on the sideboard behind. Window light mixed with an overhead fixture, a little blur from his laughing. IMPORTANT: his teeth are realistic, even, natural-looking dentures; no distorted mouths or teeth. No logos or readable text. Ordinary, crooked, unposed family snapshot. IMPORTANT: no boxes, cartons or packaging anywhere on the table; only food, plates, glasses and a bread basket.
